services.name: Nationality Rooms Summer Camp
services.desc: Give your young artist a summer experience unlike any other with three immersive mornings exploring the world through the historic Nationality & Heritage Rooms, followed by hands‑on artmaking inspired by global traditions. This intimate camp blends cultural discovery, storytelling, and studio creativity, all designed especially for curious kids ready to expand their artistic horizons. For more information please visit our website: www.nationalityrooms.pitt.edu/summer-art-camp Nationality Rooms and Intercultural Exchange Programs 1209 Cathedral of Learning University of Pittsburgh Pittsburgh, PA
